_about: Ample Guitar M 4.1.0, measured on the Windows VM (demo / trial copy) with amphost and MuseScore's own renders. Numbers only (no Ample data). Written by tools/ample/measure_ample.py merge, read by gen_ample.py through ample_products.py. Sources per key in _sources (private reports on the owner's dev machine).

_sources.vst3Parameters: amphost info: 124 real parameters (2204 with the 16 x 130 MIDI CC proxies)
_sources.sampleSets: state diff m32 / t00 (ample-state RESULT.md); proof h03
_sources.maxVelocity: velocity 127 on Sustain plays Pop (meas, centroid 3.5-4.7 kHz)
_sources.strumVelocity: strum keys' band 96-126 plays all six strings; 110 inside it (meas2 A)
_sources.strumLevels: meas3 item 1: CC7 at which the recorded strum equals a six-string roll; Pick = Finger's (assumed)
_sources.softStrum: meas3: rolls darker than a CC7-lowered strum only at v <= 30
_sources.rollGap: meas3: 10-25 ms inside the recorded strums' spread
_sources.softRoll: meas3 level pairs v20 10 ms / v40 15 ms
_sources.capoLead: 2026-10-20, amphost, 80 trials at blocks 64-2048: a change applies from the next process block
_sources.backgroundLoad: FIX4 (check of build 455): sample set loads on Ample's thread after setState, ~0.6 s of one core; offline renders wait at most 60 s
_sources.controlDefaults: the default state's <Control> map (ample-state RESULT.md; proof h07)
_sources.velocityLayers: the default state's <Layer> (s16 / s19; proof h09)
_sources.stateOnly: the default state's <Parameter>s that are no VST 3 parameter: 208 of 330
_sources.keyswitchesSounding: meas: keys 24-30 each change the note
